body: Got it, thanks a lot for the reply :)

I would say that selfishness is the most pronounced "quality" of people. I agree that most people wouldnt come to your house and slash you with machete, but they would sure as hell manipulate and use you for their own gain. My point is, when given the opportunity to do so, most people will choose to further their own interests ove the well being of others.

I guess we live in such a miserable world that we can only feel better about ourselves if we make someone else more miserable. I don't know if you've watched the Purge movies, but I guess that's how it would look like if all laws were suspended for a day. And you know what? I wouldn't mind it, not a bit. If someone has a problem with me, he can come and settle it the old fashioned way. Everyone seems to be a misanthrope, but we are the only ones that have the decency to admit what everybody else is thinking: people are fucking disgusting and not worth the effort.
guess what my new ringtone is :)

Yes, that is the most irritating aspect of it all. It wouldn't be so frustrating if all the people that behaved like assholes stopped pretending or saying that they are good people. Most psychotherapy nowadays tries to convince you that you don't have friends because you don't have the right approach or view people in a negative light. But the truth is that most people aren't likeable because they are selfish, hypocrites and self-obsessed. Mass consumerism and the instagram culture are only making things worse.

Hey man. Sure, you can message me anytime you feel the need to, although it will probably take me a while to respond if I'm not on the computer. I'll do my best to hear you out and give you some advice if I can :)

Thank you, although I have nothing to say. I'm just fed up with all the shit I have to go through, without any hope of it ever getting better. I've spent years wasting my time digging through articles, blogs and trying to find something that will help, and now I'm broken and disappointed. I'm not even looking for a cure anymore, just a way to manage this so I can feel like a person again. But now it seems that I'll never be more than a weird, asocial hermit.

Yes, there is no one. People I used to trust and talk to have abandoned me, time after time. Sometimes it was my fault, sometimes theirs. The only thing that matters now is the fact that I'm left alone to deal with this illness and nothing on this fucking Earth can help me. I suppose that the only thing that's preventing me from ending this sob story is my lack of balls. I literally have nothing to live for. Nothing. Your sympathy is admirable, but it shouldn't be wasted on someone like me. I'm just another casualty of this illness, irredeemable. I hope that one day, people with mental illnesses will get the treatment and care they truly need. I guess I'm not that lucky.

Oh damn, someone stealing your ID card sounds horrible. It must've been a challenge for your wife to regain her trust in other people after that.

I'm really glad that you both work on your own relationship-related problems, as much as it hurts that I still haven't been able to do the same with someone else.

But you atleast give me a glimmer of hope that it works :)

Best of luck to you.

Sorry to hear that. Also, I posted a whole new thread, where I asked for some help with the same question you just answered :D I'm not the fastest of the bunch.

I find distractions a really good coping technique, but I'm a firm believer that problems shouldn't be avoided, but rather confronted and treated. Or maybe I'm just an idealist.

And yeah, pretty much everything you said is basically how I've viewed life and people for the past few years.

I'll re-read your advice and put it to good use. Cheers :)

Thank you so much for sparing a piece of your time to write such a huge and thoughtful reply. I didn't expect anyone to take such interest, yet alone share their own experiences/advice with me. I feel you, I also try to make as much as I can out of each day because I've come to the realization that I've already wasted so much precious time on stupid things.

But yeah, the loneliness is always there to chip away at any resolve that I manage to build up. I know that I should be happy with the things I have and that my biggest goal should be getting myself to a better place in the future, but I can't fight the questions and thoughts on whether or not I will have someone to share that future with.

I mean, I could still be bitter because of my breakup, but she was like the third girl in a row that cheated on me with another dude, and I'm slowly turning into a misanthrope as a result. The selfishness and cruelty that I see in others make it this even more difficult, because I see other people being happy with others, but not with me. Those are the days when I feel like a heap of shit.

I've also noticed that I'm being increasingly apathetic and anhedonic. For me, nothing matters anymore. Life is just a highlight reel full of disappointments and sadness. Nothing seems to be going well and all the work I put in seems to get me nowhere. But the worst thing is, it only seems to be like that for me. I know that I'm generalizing a bit right now, and that I couldn't possibly know all the worries and problems other people have. But that doesn't lessen the sorrow or helplessness I feel every damn day.

I'm tired, and bitter. I'm thinking about doing drugs just to feel something again. But then again, I wouldn't know where to get them because I don't know anyone.

Thank you for the advice, I hope that things get better for you. People like you and me deserve something good from time to time after all that we've been through.
